breakdown.description: Inviscid (zero viscosity) is incompatible with diffusion flame which relies on viscous/diffusive transport. The simulation must use sutherland transport, not zero viscosity.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. While it correctly added the instruction "Use Sutherland transport", it also repeated the user's incorrect instruction "Set viscosity = 0 everywhere to represent an inviscid flame." These two instructions are contradictory. A diffusion flame requires viscosity for species to mix and react, making an inviscid setup physically incorrect. The Sutherland model is used to calculate a non-zero, temperature-dependent viscosity, so setting viscosity to zero negates the purpose of using Sutherland transport and reintroduces the original error.
